title: Japanese humble motion and figurative verb public development contrasts

provenance.sentence_provenance: All five Japanese sentences were written for this draft. No dictionary examples, corpora, or external sentence text were copied.
provenance.reference_provenance: First-party Taiwan Traditional Chinese references for the original examples, with independent language review.
provenance.external_gloss_source: Kotobank, Digital Daijisen entry for 参る; used only to check sense coverage, not to copy wording or examples.

purpose: Contrast humble movement to a stated place and to the listener side, ordinary polite 行く and 来る controls, and the figurative overwhelmed sense of 参る.

review_and_adoption.process: Independent language review and adoption must be recorded in a separate data-only PR before any rule uses these rows for acceptance.
review_and_adoption.scope_limit: The five original rows cover specific humble motion and figurative readings, with ordinary movement controls. They do not score the fixed sample.

items.jp: 担当者は明日、別館の会議室へ参ります。
items.zh_hant: 負責人明天會前往另一棟的會議室。
semantic_checks: 担当者 is the subject; 別館の会議室へ marks a destination, and the listener’s location is unspecified.
参ります uses polite humble 参る. The source does not identify how the person in charge relates to the speaker.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not identify the person in charge or state why they will go.

control.source_cue: 担当者 is the subject; 別館の会議室へ marks a destination, and the listener’s location is unspecified.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples humble movement toward a stated place.
limits: This row samples only its stated contrast and does not define every use of 参る.

items.jp: 明日の午後、そちらへ参ります。
semantic_checks: そちらへ marks the listener-side destination; the source leaves the subject implicit.
The reference preserves the direction without identifying the traveler.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state the traveler’s starting point or purpose.

items.zh_hant: 負責人明天會去另一棟的會議室。
semantic_checks: 行きます is ordinary polite 行く, contrasting with humble 参ります in MAIRU-DEV-01.
The subject and destination match MAIRU-DEV-01.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not identify the person in charge or state why they will go.

items.jp: 明日の午後、こちらへ来ます。
semantic_checks: 来ます is ordinary polite 来る; こちらへ marks the speaker-side destination, and the subject is omitted.
This contrasts direction with MAIRU-DEV-02, whose destination is on the listener side.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state the traveler or the purpose.

stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This ordinary polite control changes the direction as well as the verb.
limits: This row samples only its stated contrast and does not define every use of 参る.

items.jp: 何度説明しても同じ質問が続き、参りました。
items.zh_hant: 解釋好幾次後還是一直被問同樣的問題，真讓人沒轍。
semantic_checks: 参りました is a figurative expression of being at a loss or overwhelmed, not physical movement.
The preceding clause gives the situation; the Chinese reference does not identify who asked the questions.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state who asked the questions or what response followed.
